blocks.en: Of course, the question of what assumptions a boundary-value problem must satisfy for such operators to exist is of crucial importance; we shall return to this issue later when we discuss elliptic boundary-value problems. For the moment, we simply take the existence of the $S_j$, $T_j$ and $C_j$ for granted.
blocks.zh: 当然, 边值问题必须满足什么假设才能使这样的算子存在, 是极为重要的问题; 稍后讨论椭圆边值问题时将回到这一问题. 目前, 只把 $S_j$, $T_j$ 和 $C_j$ 的存在视为已知.

blocks.en: Let $v\in C^{2p}(\overline\Omega)$ and let $X_B$ denote the set of all $u\in C^{2p}(\overline\Omega)$ such that $B_ju=0$ on $\partial\Omega$ for $j=1,\ldots,p$. Then $(v,Lu)=(L^*v,u)$ for every $u\in X_B$ iff $C_jv=0$ for $j=1,\ldots,p$.
blocks.zh: 设 $v\in C^{2p}(\overline\Omega)$, 并用 $X_B$ 表示所有在 $\partial\Omega$ 上对 $j=1,\ldots,p$ 满足 $B_ju=0$ 的 $u\in C^{2p}(\overline\Omega)$ 组成的集合. 那么, 对每个 $u\in X_B$ 都有 $(v,Lu)=(L^*v,u)$ 的充分必要条件是对 $j=1,\ldots,p$ 有 $C_jv=0$.

blocks.en:
Thus, although there may be different sets of adjoint boundary conditions, they must be equivalent to each other. As a caution, we note that equivalent sets of boundary conditions need not be linear combinations of each other. For example, let $\partial\Omega$ be a closed curve in $\mathbb{R}^2$ and let $s$ denote arclength. Then the conditions $v=0$ and $\mathrm{d}v/\mathrm{d}s+v=0$ are equivalent, although they are not multiples of each other.

blocks.zh:
因此, 尽管可能存在不同的伴随边界条件组, 它们必定彼此等价. 需要提醒的是, 等价的边界条件组不必互为线性组合. 例如, 设 $\partial\Omega$ 为 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 中的闭曲线, 并用 $s$ 表示弧长. 那么条件 $v=0$ 和 $\mathrm{d}v/\mathrm{d}s+v=0$ 等价, 尽管它们并不互为倍数.
